angle: new_interface_method on log.Logger — a 6-method CLI logging interface with two implementors at opposite ends of the repository: one exported stub in the same package (NopLogger) and one unexported production implementation buried in package main (stderrLogger)
difficulty_notes: The interface has only 2 concrete implementors. NopLogger in pkg/log/nop.go is easy to find — it lives in the same package as the interface definition and is the obvious 'nop' stub. The hard one is stderrLogger in cmd/flux/log.go: it is unexported (lowercase), lives in package main, and is structurally unrelated to the interface definition directory. Models that search for 'implements Logger' or grep for the method names will find both, but models that do a shallow directory scan of pkg/log/ will find only NopLogger and miss stderrLogger entirely. The secondary trap is that pkg/uninstall/uninstall.go, pkg/status/status.go, and pkg/bootstrap/ all hold log.Logger as a field or parameter — they are consumers, not implementors, and do NOT fail to compile.
